cards.front: Recall a key point about Genetics and Inheritance
cards.back: DNA: antiparallel strands, complementary base pairing (A-T, G-C), sugar-phosphate backbone; Replication: helicase, DNA polymerase, Okazaki fragments, ligase

cards.front: Recall a key point about Genetics and Inheritance
cards.back: Transcription: RNA pol, promoter, mRNA; Translation: tRNA, ribosome, codon-anticodon, start/stop codons; Eukaryotes: splicing (introns/exons), 5' cap, poly-A tail

cards.front: Recall a key point about Genetics and Inheritance
cards.back: Mendel: segregation, independent assortment; Punnett squares; Test cross: unknown x homozygous recessive

cards.front: Recall a key point about Genetics and Inheritance
cards.back: Linkage: genes on same chromosome; recombination frequency ∝ distance; Epistasis: one gene masks another (e.g. 9:3:4, 12:3:1, 9:7 ratios)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Genetics and Inheritance
cards.back: Chi-squared: χ^2 = Σ(O-E)^2/E; df = n-1; p>0.05 = accept null (observed = expected)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Genetics and Inheritance
cards.back: Mutations: substitution (silent/missense/nonsense), insertion/deletion (frameshift); Chromosomal: deletion, duplication, inversion, translocation, non-disjunction
